content: {"reasoning":"Required authorization is missing, and the retroactive authorization window has closed; there is no denial to appeal and peer-to-peer review is unavailable. Submit the initial claim with supporting records to obtain an adjudication and document medical necessity for any subsequent appeal, recognizing that records do not replace authorization. The remaining deductible alone does not establish patient liability for a missing-authorization denial, so billing the patient or writing off the claim is premature.","action":"submit_with_records"}
